name: playwright-demo
description: Enterprise Playwright QE Framework for Open Banking CDR, API Validation, Contract Testing, Database Reconciliation, Accessibility, Performance Validation, and Enterprise Reporting

scripts.test:daily: npm run test:st && npm run test:sit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:accessibility
scripts.test:enterprise: npx playwright test tests/api/cdr tests/database tests/performance tests/accessibility
scripts.test:enterprise:allure: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npx playwright test tests/api/cdr tests/database tests/performance tests/accessibility --reporter=line,allure-playwright && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report
